data.summary: policy.apply's auto-after-retries rule (RETRY_VERBS includes approve.partial, policy.py:37, 269-275) never consults the rule predicates or GA.person_only, so with [approvals].auto_approve_after_retries=2 an agent that files approve.partial twice for a person-only measured baseline-red partial is answered by policy:auto-after-retries, the same hole B7657fc26be closed for accept_baseline_red. Fix: exclude approve.partial for a GA.person_only gate from the retry rule (or drop the verb from RETRY_VERBS); test: agent approve x3 under the retry rule over a person-only partial stays refused.

data.body:
Fixes bug B1bc4733e43: policy.apply's auto-after-retries rule (RETRY_VERBS includes approve.partial, policy.py:37, 269-275) never consults the rule predicates or GA.person_only, so with [approvals].auto_approve_after_retries=2 an agent that files approve.partial twice for a person-only measured baseline-red partial is answered by policy:auto-after-retries, the same hole B7657fc26be closed for accept_baseline_red. Fix: exclude approve.partial for a GA.person_only gate from the retry rule (or drop the verb from RETRY_VERBS); test: agent approve x3 under the retry rule over a person-only partial stays refused.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B1bc4733e43 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B1bc4733e43 --regression-test <test>` first).
